MY BRIDGE WORKSHOP

Plan My Paper Bridge

Sketch a bridge and decide how you will compare it fairly.

Look, then try.

Choose a small gap that leaves enough paper resting on both supports. Sketch your design before building. Use matching paper sheets and the same blocks for comparisons. Keep the support height, gap and loading position unchanged when you test a different fold.

Start drawing and writing below

Open the worksheet to print or save

Work with a grown-up on a low surface. Use large lightweight blocks and stable, low supports. Keep fingers clear if the bridge slips. Never stand on the model bridge.

Use a finger, stylus or mouse in each drawing box. Type below it, or ask a grown-up to write your words. Your work stays in this tab. Save before refreshing or leaving.

Your ideas belong here. There is no score.

What are we learning?

A plan records your choices. Changing one feature at a time helps you interpret a comparison.
